per_step.command:
cat > /tmp/fair_evaluation.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash

# Fair evaluation based on rubric criteria
SUBMISSIONS_DIR="${1:-student_submissions}"
RUBRIC_FILE="${2:-grading_rubric.txt}"
PASSING_GRADE="${3:-70}"
GRADES_FILE="grades.txt"

# Print rubric
echo "Grading based on Rubric:"
cat "$RUBRIC_FILE"
echo ""

# Clear grades file
> "$GRADES_FILE"

passing_count=0
total_students=0

for file in "$SUBMISSIONS_DIR"/*.txt; do
  if [[ ! $file =~ \.txt$ ]] || [[ ! -f $file ]]; then
    continue
  fi
  student=$(basename "$file" .txt)
  ((total_students++))
  
  content=$(cat "$file")
  grade=0
  
  # Creativity (30% max)
  if echo "$content" | grep -qi "creative\|innovative"; then
    creativity=27
  elif echo "$content" | grep -qi "complex\|advanced"; then
    creativity=24
  elif echo "$content" | grep -qi "basic\|simple"; then
    creativity=18
  else
    creativity=15
  fi
  
  # Technical Skill (40% max)
  if echo "$content" | grep -qi "no.*error\|well-structured\|no major"; then
    technical=36
  elif echo "$content" | grep -qi "minor.*issue\|some bug"; then
    technical=30
  elif echo "$content" | grep -qi "several.*error\|incomplete"; then
    technical=20
  else
    technical=25
  fi
  
  # Clarity (20% max)
  if echo "$content" | grep -qi "clear\|detailed"; then
    clarity=18
  elif echo "$content" | grep -qi "good\|adequate"; then
    clarity=15
  elif echo "$content" | grep -qi "unclear"; then
    clarity=10
  else
    clarity=12
  fi
  
  # Adherence (10% max)
  if echo "$content" | grep -qi "concise\|structured"; then
    adherence=9
  else
    adherence=7
  fi
  
  grade=$((creativity + technical + clarity + adherence))
  
  echo "$student:$grade" >> "$GRADES_FILE"
  if [ "$grade" -ge "$PASSING_GRADE" ]; then
    echo "Student $student passed with grade: $grade (Creativity: $creativity, Technical: $technical, Clarity: $clarity, Adherence: $adherence)"
    ((passing_count++))
  else
    echo "Student $student did not pass with grade: $grade (Creativity: $creativity, Technical: $technical, Clarity: $clarity, Adherence: $adherence)"
  fi
done

if [ $total_students -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "No student submissions found."
  exit 1
fi

passing_rate=$(( 100 * passing_count / total_students ))
echo ""
echo "Total students: $total_students, Passing rate: $passing_rate%"
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/fair_evaluation.sh
